## The Corrected Path

```go
type Cache struct {
    data     sync.Map                    // Thread-safe map
    mu       sync.Mutex                  // For loading coordination
    inflight map[string]chan struct{}    // Singleflight pattern
    stats    atomic.Int64                // Hits
    // ... similar for other stats
}

func (c *Cache) Get(ctx context.Context, key string) (interface{}, error) {
    // Safe read
    if entry, ok := c.data.Load(key); ok {
        e := entry.(*CacheEntry)
        if time.Now().Before(e.ExpiresAt) {
            c.hits.Add(1)
            return e.Value, nil
        }
    }
    
    c.mu.Lock()
    if ch, ok := c.inflight[key]; ok {
        c.mu.Unlock()
        <-ch  // Wait on channel, not busy-wait
        return c.Get(ctx, key)
    }
    ch := make(chan struct{})
    c.inflight[key] = ch
    c.mu.Unlock()
    
    defer func() {
        c.mu.Lock()
        delete(c.inflight, key)
        close(ch)
        c.mu.Unlock()
    }()
    
    value, err := c.loader(ctx, key)
    if err != nil {
        return nil, err
    }
    
    c.data.Store(key, &CacheEntry{Value: value, ExpiresAt: time.Now().Add(c.ttl)})
    return value, nil
}
```

Use `sync.WaitGroup` for `GetMulti`. Use `atomic.Bool` for cleaning flag. Protect ALL map access.
